properties.approach_notes: Village-centre roadside target; confirm legal parking locally.
properties.name: Stĺp hanby, Bernolákovo
properties.notes: Small peculiar first stop rather than a major destination.

properties.approach_notes: Route only to mapped parking west of the reservoir.
properties.name: Kučišdorfská priehrada
properties.notes: Short waterside stop that positions the ride for the northern vineyard and forest edge.

properties.approach_notes: Park at the mapped parking area and walk; a nearby asphalt service way is tagged motor_vehicle=no.
properties.name: Miesto poranenia Ľudovíta Štúra
properties.notes: Strong small-story destination. Treat it as a short walk, not a motorcycle-access target.

properties.approach_notes: Route to mapped parking east of the well; inspect signs and walk the remaining section.
properties.name: Vahadlová studňa
properties.notes: Deliberately obscure discovery candidate. Verify physical condition and walking access in the field.

properties.approach_notes: Route to the mapped street-side parking and continue on foot. Do not use the nearby private track.
properties.name: Kaplnka sv. Urbana
properties.notes: A compact Rača winegrowing-history target. Parking suitability and current signs need field verification.

properties.approach_notes: Urban roadside target. Use only a legal nearby stopping place.
properties.name: Socha sv. Floriána
properties.notes: Small historic object that pairs naturally with the two other Rača discoveries.

properties.approach_notes: The memorial is beside mapped residential and service roads. Confirm a legal stopping place on arrival.
properties.name: Začatie stavby V. koridoru
properties.notes: Very minor infrastructure oddity; useful as a quick urban detour rather than a destination ride.

properties.approach_notes: Leave the motorcycle at the mapped public asphalt parking in Svätý Jur and walk to the ruins. Do not route a motorcycle onto forest paths.
properties.name: Biely Kameň
properties.notes: The largest destination in this batch, retained as a park-and-walk stop rather than a motorcycle-access target.

properties.approach_notes: Park at the mapped parking area near Panónska and walk roughly 100 m east beside the railway. Verify parking signs.
properties.name: Pamätník Ray Wallace Allen
properties.notes: Strong obscure-story target. The object itself is reached on foot from the approach parking.

properties.approach_notes: Park at the mapped cemetery parking and enter on foot. Respect cemetery opening hours and rules.
properties.name: Ségnerovská hrobka
properties.notes: Compact town stop that can be combined with the Allen memorial and vineyard tower.

properties.approach_notes: Use the mapped parking area east of the vineyards and walk to the tower. Verify parking restrictions and the current foot route.
properties.name: Rozhľadňa nad vinohradníckym skanzenom
properties.notes: Promising small viewpoint, but the approach and parking need field confirmation.
